reason: The preregistered claim that all seven datasets were genuinely unseen is false. Repository provenance shows prior exposure of three datasets before v0.61.

retained_evidence.interpretation: These remain reproducible mixed-development/external benchmark measurements, but they cannot support a clean blind or external-breakthrough claim.

required_repair: Run a new archive-lock and evaluation on a repository-audited suite containing no dataset, derivative, split, archive hash, or named source previously used by Mini-ORIGIN. Preserve the v0.60 generator and all v0.61 thresholds unchanged.
claim_scope: v0.61 is not a valid clean blind breakthrough. It is preserved as contaminated evidence and must not be described as world-level, world-first, or independently externally confirmed.
